comment: The Haro v0.13 conformance floor, written BEFORE the court that passes it (the W discipline: fixtures first, prose second). v0.13 grows v0.12 by the charter's last section-3 row, NARRATE -- how a run of the language is narrated back, the court's voice (stzn): NARRATE, at most one per language, with SAYS (a template per declaration kind, kind: "text"), OPENS (the line before the declarations), ENDS (the line after) and REFUSES (the line when the court stops). A template may fill {name}, {verb}, {rationale}, {line} and any seat of its kind (R2); OPENS and ENDS fill {language}, {file} and {count}; REFUSES fills {language}, {file}, {line}, {code}, {message} and {cites} (R5); every brace must close (R4); SAYS names declared kinds (R1), each once (R6); at most one NARRATE (R3). The narration is a projection from the sentence and never parsed back, which the court keeps by having no verb that reads one. Every v0.12 fixture still passes: v0.13 refuses nothing v0.12 accepted (A2 is v0.12's A1).

accepts.name: a NARRATE with a template per kind, an opening, an ending and a refusal
accepts.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE shop AS (VERSION "0.13", GRAMMAR "0.13", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".shop") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION item AS (VERB "ITEM", SEATS [price: number, label: text]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION till AS (VERB "TILL", SEATS [holds: name]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE NARRATE voice AS (OPENS "{file}: {count} things in {language}.", SAYS [item: "{name} costs {price} and is called {label}. {rationale}", till: "{verb} {name} holds {holds}, line {line}."], ENDS "That is all.", REFUSES "Stopped at line {line} with {code}: {message} ({cites})") RATIONALE "x"

accepts.name: a v0.12 declaration is a v0.13 declaration: v0.12's A1, unchanged
accepts.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE stzv AS (VERSION "0.12", GRAMMAR "0.12", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".stzv") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE MENU offered AS (WORDS [cs, st, xt, many, fluent, passive]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION family AS (VERB "FAMILY", SEATS [base: text, forms: [offered]?]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE FORMS stz AS (FLUENT "Q", PASSIVE "ed", STATEMENT "X", PARAMS [cs: "CS", st: "ST", xt: "XT", many: "Many"], FAMILY [family, base, forms]) RATIONALE "x"

accepts.name: a NARRATE of SAYS alone: the opening, ending and refusal take the court's own plain words
accepts.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE shop AS (VERSION "0.13", GRAMMAR "0.13", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".shop") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION till AS (VERB "TILL", SEATS [holds: name]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE NARRATE voice AS (SAYS [till: "{name} holds {holds}"]) RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: SAYS names a declaration kind the language does not declare
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE shop AS (VERSION "0.13", GRAMMAR "0.13", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".shop") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION till AS (VERB "TILL", SEATS [holds: name]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE NARRATE voice AS (SAYS [drawer: "{name}"]) RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: a template fills only the placeholders its kind has: a seat the kind lacks is refused
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE shop AS (VERSION "0.13", GRAMMAR "0.13", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".shop") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION till AS (VERB "TILL", SEATS [holds: name]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE NARRATE voice AS (SAYS [till: "{name} holds {colour}"]) RATIONALE "x"
rejects.refusal: '{colour}' in SAYS till is not a placeholder the voice can fill

rejects.name: a language has one voice
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE shop AS (VERSION "0.13", GRAMMAR "0.13", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".shop") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION till AS (VERB "TILL", SEATS [holds: name]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE NARRATE one AS (SAYS [till: "{name}"]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE NARRATE two AS (SAYS [till: "{name}"]) RATIONALE "x"
rejects.refusal: a .haro file declares at most one NARRATE

rejects.name: every brace closes
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE shop AS (VERSION "0.13", GRAMMAR "0.13", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".shop") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION till AS (VERB "TILL", SEATS [holds: name]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE NARRATE voice AS (SAYS [till: "{name holds"]) RATIONALE "x"
rejects.refusal: a '{' is never closed in SAYS till

rejects.name: OPENS has no {name}: it speaks before any declaration
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE shop AS (VERSION "0.13", GRAMMAR "0.13", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".shop") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION till AS (VERB "TILL", SEATS [holds: name]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE NARRATE voice AS (OPENS "{name} begins", SAYS [till: "{name}"]) RATIONALE "x"
rejects.refusal: '{name}' in OPENS is not a placeholder the voice can fill

rejects.name: a kind is voiced once
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE shop AS (VERSION "0.13", GRAMMAR "0.13", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".shop") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION till AS (VERB "TILL", SEATS [holds: name]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE NARRATE voice AS (SAYS [till: "{name}", till: "{holds}"]) RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: a voice that says nothing narrates nothing
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE shop AS (VERSION "0.13", GRAMMAR "0.13", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".shop") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION till AS (VERB "TILL", SEATS [holds: name]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE NARRATE voice AS (OPENS "{file}") RATIONALE "x"
